dialogue.origin: はじめましてよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I look forward to working with you too.

dialogue.origin: 予定時刻に開始させてもらいます。
dialogue.content: We will begin at the scheduled time.

dialogue.origin: 予定時刻に開始させてもらいます。
dialogue.content: We will begin at the scheduled time.

dialogue.origin: 何かご要望があったらおっしゃってください^^
dialogue.content: If you have any requests, please let me know. ^^

dialogue.origin: お気遣いありがとうございます。要望は特にないです。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your consideration. I don't have any particular requests. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 14歳女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 14-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: なんかもう全部がどーでもよくて
dialogue.content: I kind of feel like nothing matters anymore.

dialogue.origin: 全部どうでもよくなったのですね。そう感じるようになったきっかけはありますか？
dialogue.content: So it feels like everything has become meaningless to you. Was there anything that led you to feel that way?

dialogue.origin: べつに
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: なんにもやりたくないときってありますよね。
dialogue.content: There are times when you just don't feel like doing anything, right?

dialogue.origin: まあね
dialogue.content: Yeah, I guess.

dialogue.origin: 休みの日は普段どのように過ごしてますか？
dialogue.content: How do you usually spend your days off?

dialogue.origin: 家でゲームしてる
dialogue.content: I play games at home.

dialogue.origin: ゲームしているのですね。楽しそうですね。
dialogue.content: You play games, I see. That sounds fun.

dialogue.origin: べつに
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: そういう考えなんですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you see it.

dialogue.origin: そういう考えって？
dialogue.content: What do you mean, 'how I see it'?

dialogue.origin: ゲームについてですね。
dialogue.content: About the games.

dialogue.origin: あ〜
dialogue.content: Oh...

dialogue.origin: もしよければ何にどうでもよくなったか具体的教えてもってもいいですか？
dialogue.content: If you’re comfortable, could you tell me more specifically what things you feel don’t matter anymore?

dialogue.origin: 親も学校も全部どうでもいい感じ
dialogue.content: My parents, school... everything just feels like it doesn't matter.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことに関してどうでもよくなったのですね。関わることがめんどくさいって気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.content: So you've come to feel that those things don't matter. It can feel like a hassle to deal with it all, can't it?

dialogue.origin: まあ
dialogue.content: I guess.

dialogue.origin: 差支えなければ学校がどうでもよくなったきっかけを具体的に聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: If you don’t mind, could I ask specifically what led you to feel that school doesn’t matter?

dialogue.origin: 先生もうざいし
dialogue.content: The teacher is annoying, too.

dialogue.origin: 確かにめんどくさいと行きたくないですね。
dialogue.content: I can see how that would make you not want to go.

dialogue.origin: まあ
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: いつから先生をめんどくさいと感じるようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: When did you start to find your teacher annoying?

dialogue.origin: 中2になってから
dialogue.content: Since I started my second year of middle school.

dialogue.origin: 中学2年生になってからですね。中学1年生のときはうざいと感じませんでしたか？
dialogue.content: So, since you became a second-year middle school student. Did you not find him annoying in your first year?

dialogue.origin: 他の先生だったから
dialogue.content: I had a different teacher.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、確かに新しい先生で相性が合わないとめんどくさいそう。今の先生はどのようなことにうざいと感じますか？
dialogue.content: I see. With a new teacher, if you don’t click, it can be tough. What is it about your current teacher that you find annoying?

dialogue.origin: おせっかいだし、いろいろ聞いてくるし、うざい
dialogue.content: He's nosy, asks too many questions... it's just annoying.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、なんでも聞かれるとめんどくさいですね。やりたいことしてもいちいち聞かれるとだるいし
dialogue.content: I understand—being asked about everything can feel like a hassle. Even when you’re doing what you want, being questioned every time can be draining.

dialogue.origin: まあね
dialogue.content: Yeah, pretty much.

dialogue.origin: ってかわかったふりしてくる何もわかってないくせに
dialogue.content: And he pretends to understand, but he doesn't get it at all.

dialogue.origin: そう感じるのですね。
dialogue.content: That’s how it feels to you.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 全部はわかりませんがあなたが先生にうざいと感じていることはわかりますよ。
dialogue.content: I may not understand everything, but I do understand that you find your teacher annoying.

dialogue.origin: ありがと
dialogue.content: Thanks.

dialogue.origin: いえいえなので一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: You’re welcome. So let’s think it through together.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 親にはどうしてうざいと感じるのですか？
dialogue.content: What is it about your parents that you find annoying?

dialogue.origin: 勉強しろしか言わないし
dialogue.content: All they ever say is, 'Study.'

dialogue.origin: 確かにそれしか言われなかったらやる気なくしますよね。
dialogue.content: I can see how hearing only that would sap your motivation.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 親に関してはいつからそう感じていますか？
dialogue.content: When did you start feeling that way about your parents?

dialogue.origin: 中学入ってから
dialogue.content: Since I started middle school.

dialogue.origin: 中学入ってからうるさくなったのですね。よく一年間も耐えて頑張ってきましたね。
dialogue.content: So they've been nagging you more since you started middle school. You've done well to endure it for a whole year.

dialogue.origin: まあ　がんばってはないけど
dialogue.content: Well, I wouldn't say I've been trying hard.

dialogue.origin: 先生からも言われるようになってから全部がどうでもよくなってきたのですか？
dialogue.content: Did you start to feel like nothing matters after your teacher started saying things too?

dialogue.origin: もうみんなだまれって感じ
dialogue.content: It's like, I just want everyone to shut up.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、毎回言われたらなんも言わないでほしいですよね。やろうとしてるときに言われたらやる気なくすし
dialogue.content: Right. If you hear it all the time, you just wish they'd stop. And it kills your motivation when they say it right as you're about to do something.

dialogue.origin: まあ
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 学校はその先生がいなかったら楽しいと感じますか？
dialogue.content: Do you think school would be fun if that teacher weren't there?

dialogue.origin: 思う
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: 思うんですね。今回は先生と親から言われなくようになったら楽になると感じますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you think you would feel more at ease if your teacher and parents stopped nagging you?

dialogue.origin: そりゃね
dialogue.content: Yeah, of course.

dialogue.origin: 確かに言われなくなった気持ちが楽になりそうですね。誰かそのことに関して相談できる人はいますか？
dialogue.content: Right—if they stopped, it would likely feel lighter. Is there anyone you can talk to about this?

dialogue.origin: 友達とは話すけど
dialogue.content: I talk to my friends about it, but...

dialogue.origin: 友達には話すのですね。どのように言われますか？
dialogue.content: You talk to your friends, I see. What do they say?

dialogue.origin: みんな同じこと言ってるからグチっておわる
dialogue.content: Everyone says the same thing, so we just vent and that's it.

dialogue.origin: 周りのみんなもうざいと感じるのですね。そうなるとみんな先生を嫌いになりますね。
dialogue.content: So everyone around you finds him annoying, too. In that case, it makes sense that everyone ends up disliking the teacher.

dialogue.origin: だね
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 最初にうざいと思ったときのエピソードってありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there a specific incident when you first thought he was annoying?

dialogue.origin: べつにないって言うか中学入ってからずっと勉強しろって言い出したから
dialogue.content: Not really a specific incident... it's just that they started telling me to study all the time since I started middle school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど勉強しろって言われてうざいと感じたのですね。確かに親と同じことを言い出したらめんどくさいですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so you felt annoyed when you were told to study. It's definitely a hassle if your teacher starts saying the same things as your parents, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 先生の話？
dialogue.content: Are we talking about the teacher?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 先生には言われない
dialogue.content: The teacher doesn't say that.

dialogue.origin: 先生には言われないのですね。先生には何に言われてうざいと感じるようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: Oh, the teacher doesn't say that. What does the teacher say that you find annoying?

dialogue.origin: ジジィだからキモいんだよね
dialogue.content: He's an old geezer, so he's creepy.

dialogue.origin: 高齢の先生だから嫌なのですね。
dialogue.content: So you don't like him because he's an older teacher.

dialogue.origin: くせえし
dialogue.content: And he stinks.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 他にはありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: 近寄るなって思う
dialogue.content: I just wish he wouldn't come near me.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそれぐらいうざいと感じるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how annoying you find him.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ございません。お時間になりましたので次回また相談してもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.content: I'm very sorry, but our time is up for today. Would it be alright if we continue this discussion next time?

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: それでは、本日のご相談はここで終了とさせていただきます。お時間を作ってお話をお聞かせいただき、どうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: In that case, we'll end today's consultation here. Thank you very much for taking the time to share your story with me.

topic.sub: 教師に対する不満とストレス
